title: 第一卷 第96章 你来我往
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

御花园的梅花开得正盛，红梅白雪，煞是好看。

长乐公主以赏梅为名，邀叶笙歌至暖阁小坐。阁内生着炭火，暖意融融，与外间的严寒恍如两个世界。

公主只穿了一件薄薄的藕荷色衫子，外罩一件轻纱披肩，长发松松挽起，比起平日的华贵端庄，多了几分慵懒随性。

她亲手斟了两杯酒，将其中一杯推到叶笙歌面前，自己端起另一杯，也不劝酒，自顾自地抿了一口：“你与本宫合作，扳倒冯无义，事成之后，你想要什么？”

叶笙歌端起酒杯，没有立刻喝，沉默了片刻，才道：“奴才只想平安度日。”

公主闻言，笑了起来，笑声清脆，在暖阁中回荡。

她笑够了，放下酒杯，看着叶笙歌，眼中带着一丝玩味：“你不说实话。不过没关系，本宫喜欢你的谨慎。”

她没有再追问，只是又给他斟了一杯酒。

叶笙歌从暖阁出来时，天色已近黄昏。

他走在回尚膳监的路上，心中却并不轻松。公主的问话看似随意，却让他意识到扳倒冯无义之后的路，也许比扳倒他本身更难走。

次日，丽妃那边也有了动作。

她一早便去了皇后宫中，屏退左右，低声说了许久的话。

话里话外，无非是指叶笙歌身为尚膳监掌事，却频繁与宫外商贾往来，“恐有泄露宫禁之嫌”。

皇后听后，沉默了片刻，命人传叶笙歌来问话。

叶笙歌来到凤仪殿时，丽妃正坐在皇后下首，神色端庄，目光却带着一丝冷意。

皇后开门见山，将丽妃的疑虑说了。

叶笙歌听完，神色不变，从容答道：“回皇后娘娘，尚膳监每日所需食材种类繁多，仅靠宫中固定供应渠道，难以满足各宫主子的口味需求。”

“奴才与宫外商贾往来，是为拓宽采购渠道，多方比价，择优而取。”

“每一次采购，均有记录可查，每一笔交易，均有单据为证。”

“奴才愿将所有往来文书呈送皇后娘娘御览，若有半分不妥，甘受责罚。”

皇后命人取来尚膳监的采购记录，翻看了几页，又核对了叶笙歌呈上的几份比价单据，脸色渐渐缓和。

她合上册子，看向丽妃，语气平淡却带着一丝不悦：“叶尚膳的采购记录清楚明白，并无违规之处。”

“丽妃，你关心宫务是好事，但捕风捉影的话，以后还是少说为好。”

丽妃脸色一白，连忙起身告罪，不敢再多言。

叶笙歌退出凤仪殿时，脊背挺直，目不斜视。

他没有回头看丽妃的表情，但他知道，这一局，他又赢了。

然而，并非所有的战线都如此顺利。苏凌霜在夜探内官监时，不慎触发了魏无忌布下的暗哨。

东厂的暗哨训练有素，她虽凭借高超的身法脱身，却还是在左臂上被划了一道口子，鲜血浸透了夜行衣。

叶笙歌在住处为她处理伤口时，两人隔着一盏孤灯，距离极近。

Page (1/3)

The plum blossoms in the Royal Garden are in full bloom, and the red plums and white snow are really beautiful.

Princess Changle invited Ye Shengge to sit in Nuange Pavilion in the name of appreciating plum blossoms.There is a charcoal fire in the pavilion, which is warm and cozy, and seems to be two different worlds from the severe cold outside.

The princess only wore a thin lotus-colored shirt, covered with a gauze shawl, and her long hair was rolled up loosely. Compared with her usual luxurious and dignified appearance, the princess looked a little more lazy and casual.

She poured two glasses of wine with her own hands, pushed one of them in front of Ye Shengge, picked up the other glass herself, and took a sip without trying to persuade her to drink: "You cooperate with me to bring down Feng Wuyi. What do you want after that?"

Ye Shengge picked up the wine glass but did not drink it immediately. After a moment of silence, he said, "I just want to live in peace."

When the princess heard this, she laughed, and her laughter was clear and echoed in the Nuan Pavilion.

She had laughed enough, put down her wine glass, and looked at Ye Shengge with a hint of playfulness in her eyes: "You don't tell the truth. But it doesn't matter. I like your caution."

She didn't ask any more questions, just poured him another glass of wine.

When Ye Shengge came out of Nuange, it was almost dusk.

As he walked back to Shangshan Prison, his heart was not at ease.The princess's question seemed casual, but it made him realize that the road after overthrowing Feng Wuyi might be more difficult than overthrowing him himself.

The next day, Li Fei also made some moves.

She went to the Queen's Palace early in the morning, stood aside and whispered for a long time.

What he said was nothing more than a reference to the fact that Ye Shengge, as the head of the Shangshan Supervisory Committee, frequently interacted with merchants outside the palace, "for fear of leaking the palace ban."

After hearing this, the queen was silent for a moment and ordered someone to call Ye Shengge for questioning.

When Ye Shengge arrived at Fengyi Hall, Concubine Li was sitting under the Queen, with a dignified expression but a hint of coldness in her eyes.

The Queen got straight to the point and told Concubine Li's doubts.

After listening to this, Ye Shengge's expression remained unchanged and he replied calmly: "Back to the Queen, the Master of Food and Drinks requires a wide variety of ingredients every day. It is difficult to meet the taste needs of each palace master just by relying on the fixed supply channels in the palace."

"The purpose of the slaves' contacts with merchants outside the palace is to expand purchasing channels, compare prices from multiple parties, and choose the best."

“Every purchase is documented and every transaction is documented.”

"I am willing to submit all correspondence to the Queen for her inspection. If there is anything inappropriate, I am willing to be punished."

The queen ordered someone to fetch Shang Shanjian's purchasing records, flipped through a few pages, and checked several price comparison documents submitted by Ye Shengge, her expression gradually softened.

She closed the book, looked at Concubine Li, and said in a calm tone with a hint of displeasure: "Ye Shangshan's purchasing records are clear and there are no violations."

"Concubine Li, it's a good thing that you care about palace affairs, but if you are making excuses, it's better to say less in the future."

Concubine Li's face turned pale and she quickly stood up to apologize, not daring to say any more.

When Ye Shengge exited Fengyi Hall, his back was straight and his eyes were not squinting.

He did not look back at Li Fei's expression, but he knew that he had won this round again.

However, not all fronts are so smooth.When Su Lingshuang visited the internal prison at night, she accidentally triggered the secret sentry posted by Wei Wuji.

Dongchang's secret whistle was well-trained. Although she escaped with her superb body skills, she still received a cut on her left arm, and her night clothes were soaked with blood.

When Ye Shengge was treating her wounds at her residence, the two of them were very close to each other, separated by a lone lamp.
